Arthur B. Reeve, Craig Kennedy Stories.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/arthur-b-reeve/craig-kennedy-stories

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Arthur B. Reeve, the author, died 1936.

First publication of the text used: 1910 to 1912, in Cosmopolitan (United States). Wikipedia: Kennedy first appeared in the December 1910 issue of Cosmopolitan, in 'The Case of Helen Bond'. SE colophon: 'Craig Kennedy Stories was compiled from short stories published between 1910 and 1912 by Arthur B. Reeve.'

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in the United States in 1910, before 1931, so it is in the public domain in the United States.
- Country of origin: the first publication was in the United States (Cosmopolitan, from December 1910), so the country of origin is the United States, and the United States rule above settles it whatever the death year.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."
